# TORRE Group

> TORRE Group is a family group of four building-sector companies in Kosovo, active since 1999 according to the company. Official website: https://torre-ks.com

## Companies

- [MAGFA GROUP](https://torre-ks.com/magfa): builds private and residential homes in Kosovo (Prishtinë, Ferizaj, Prizren, Gjakovë, Pejë, Mitrovicë).
- [SWISSTECH](https://torre-ks.com/swisstech): manufactures and installs PVC and aluminium windows and doors in Ferizaj; factory at Rr. Engjëll Zefi, Bibaj, 70000 Ferizaj.
- [TORRE DI UMBRIA](https://torre-ks.com/torre-umbria): develops residential buildings in Kosovo.
- [TORRE HOME](https://torre-ks.com/torrehome): builds residential buildings on Emin Duraku street, Ferizaj, and sells the apartments in them.

## Contact

- [Contact page](https://torre-ks.com/kontakti)

## Notes

- Prices, warranty terms and delivery times are not published on the website. Contact the company directly.
- The website is in Albanian. English pages exist but are not yet published.
- This file mirrors the public website and is updated with it.
